密码与授权码在每次连接时输入，不保存。: The password and authentication code are entered at every connection and never saved.
密码与授权码只用于本次连接，不保存。: The password and authentication code are used for this connection only and never saved.
CTP 返回错误 {code}；核对账户信息后重新连接。: CTP returned error {code}; check the account details and connect again.
{n} 笔已记录的委托没有出现在券商回报中：{ids}。它们不会被重发，并继续占: {n} recorded orders are missing from broker reports: {ids}. They are never resent and still count against the working-order limit; verify them with the broker.
券商对本账户实际收取的保证金率与手续费；多空保证金不同时取较高者。: Margin and commission rates the broker actually charges this account; when long and short margins differ, the higher one is used.
限价须在涨跌停范围内，且与券商最新价（当日无成交时为昨结算价）的偏离不超过该比例: Limit prices must stay within the exchange's price limits and within this fraction of the broker's latest price (the pre-settlement price before the first trade), e.g. 0.02 for 2%. Each order queries the market once before it is sent, taking about a second.
合约查询失败，请核对连接信息后重试。: Contract query failed. Check the connection details and retry.
先读取柜台合约规格，不会创建委托。凭据仅用于本次查询。: Read contract specifications from the broker without placing orders. Credentials are used only for this query.
真实资金账户：授权后的委托可能产生真实成交与盈亏。: Real funds account: authorized orders can cause real executions and gains or losses.
请向开户机构核对账号及前置地址。环境由你确认，系统无法自动验证资金性质。: Verify the account and front address with your broker. You confirm the environment; the system cannot verify whether funds are real.
创建账户不会登录或发送委托。下一步确认环境、连接并授权。: Creation does not log in or submit orders. Next, confirm the environment, connect and authorize trading.
我确认使用账户 {user} 向上方柜台发送委托: I authorize account {user} to submit orders to the broker above
我已核对账户与柜台环境: I have verified the account and broker environment
已标记为 CTP 仿真；委托仍会发送到上方柜台，请确认地址正确。: Marked as CTP simulation. Orders will still be sent to the broker above; verify the address.
在券商端确认某笔委托不存在后，可将其标为已核实，它不再占用在途委托额度。: After confirming at the broker that an order does not exist, mark it verified; it stops counting against the working-order limit.
开通后柜台信息固定在此账户的交易记录中，不能再修改。: After setup the counter details are fixed in this account's trading record and can no longer be changed.
还没有 CTP 账户，请先在设置中添加。: No CTP accounts yet. Add one in Settings first.
交易服务尚未初始化。: The trading service is not initialized.
此账户的交易服务未在运行。启动只运行服务程序，不登录柜台。: This account's trading service is not running. Starting it only runs the service program; it does not log in to the counter.
断开账户会退出柜台连接，已有委托不会自动撤销。: Disconnecting the account logs out of the counter; existing orders are not cancelled automatically.
交易服务连接或记录状态不确定。请重新连接交易服务；断线命令不会自动重发。: The trading service connection or record state is uncertain. Reconnect the trading service; commands are never resent after a disconnect.
保留历史政策与命令。现有持仓和在途委托仍计入风险；变更后断开连接，需重新登录、同: Historical policies and commands are retained. Existing positions and working orders still count as exposure. Applying a policy disconnects the account; sign in, synchronize and authorize again.
新增合约前，请在行情页取得合约目录；现有合约仍可调整风险限额。: Load the contract catalog in Market before adding contracts. Risk limits for existing contracts can still be changed.
我确认应用上述政策并重新登录: I confirm this policy and will sign in again
柜台回报队列已满，新增报单已停止。请重新连接并核对账户；已有委托不会自动撤销。: The broker report queue is full and new orders are blocked. Reconnect and reconcile the account; existing orders are not automatically cancelled.
账户已连接。此窗口尚未核对柜台环境，核对后才能授权和下单。: The account is connected. This window has not confirmed the counter environment; confirm it before authorizing or placing orders.
按行情填入限价: Fill the limit price from the market
连接柜台后可查询账户费率。: Connect to the counter to query the account's rates.
委托先写入本机交易记录再发送；断线后不会自动重发。: Orders are recorded locally before they are sent and are never resent after a disconnect.
停止策略并撤单: Stop strategy and cancel its orders
已收到 {n} 根，还需 {missing} 根才有信号: {n} received; {missing} more before the first signal
策略运行期间不能手动下单；撤单、撤销授权和停止策略始终可用。账户未连接或未同步时: Manual orders are refused while a strategy runs; cancelling, revoking and stopping are always available. While the account is not connected and synchronized the strategy waits and sends nothing. Stopping only cancels the strategy's working orders and keeps positions.
授权长期有效，断线重连和换交易日后不需要再次授权；撤销授权、修改风控政策或交易服: The authorization lasts across reconnects and trading days; it ends when you revoke it, change the risk policy or the trading service restarts.
远程实例请先在运行与部署中创建；绑定后不会自动切换节点。: Deploy remote instances in Node Management first. Bound accounts never switch nodes automatically.
远程交易实例暂不支持自动策略，请使用手动交易。: Automated strategies are not yet supported on remote trading instances. Use manual trading.
尚未核对已知成交: Known fills are not yet reconciled
资金、持仓、订单和成交可能来自不同时间；同步完成时间不代表原子账本或完整历史。: Funds, positions, orders and trades may be observed at different times. Synchronization completion is neither an atomic ledger cut nor complete history.
保存当前已观察的账户事实，不查询或登录柜台，不改变授权，不发送委托。它不是完整历: Preserve currently observed account facts without querying or connecting to the broker, changing authorization or sending orders. This is not a complete historical ledger.
确认保留本次固定事实及覆盖限制: Confirm retention of these fixed facts and coverage limitations
固定或恢复原操作: Capture or resume the original operation
固定事实响应身份不符，请检查原操作: Facts response identity differs. Inspect the original operation.
账户事实已接纳，尚未发布: Account facts admitted, not yet published
继续只恢复原件；原件丢失时保持未完成，不重新获取当前观察。: Continuation restores only the original. If it is missing, the operation remains incomplete and never captures a new observation.
未取得资金观察，不能当作零余额: No funds observation is available; this is not a zero balance.
不具备完整柜台历史覆盖: Complete broker history is not covered
固定事实只用于只读证据审阅；尚未提供真实账本绩效计算。: Fixed facts support read-only evidence review. Real-ledger performance computation is not yet available.
缺少资金币种来源字段，金额仅为柜台原值: The source does not provide a funds currency field; amounts are the original broker observations.
在 Research 审阅此固定事实: Review These Fixed Facts in Research
没有可运行的策略包。实盘运行只接受 1 分钟单合约策略包，且合约须在账户风控允许: No strategy package can run. A live run takes only a single-contract one-minute strategy package whose contract the account's risk policy allows; build one from one-minute data in Research first.
策略按策略包固定的规则运行，使用本机行情服务的 1 分钟线，按 K 线收盘价挂限: The run follows the package's fixed rule on one-minute bars from this machine's market service and places limit orders at each bar's close; it takes over the contract's existing one-sided position. Once started it alone places orders and continues across reconnections and trading days until you stop it, revoke the authorization, change the risk policy or the trading service restarts.
